mapper.sql: session_id id, account_id accountId, context_type contextType, tenant_id tenantId, tenant_member_id memberId, account_auth_epoch accountEpoch, credential_version_snapshot credentialVersion, issued_time issuedTime, last_activity_time lastActivityTime, idle_expire_time idleExpireTime, absolute_expire_time absoluteExpireTime, current_generation_no generationNo, status, version

r.refresh_generation_id id, r.session_id sessionId, r.generation_no generationNo, r.token_lookup_id lookupId, r.token_secret_hmac secretHmac, r.hmac_key_version keyVersion, r.status, r.expires_time expiresTime
mapper.select: SELECT p.password_credential_id id, p.account_id accountId, p.password_verifier_phc verifier, p.algorithm_version algorithmVersion, p.memory_kib memoryKib, p.iterations, p.parallelism, p.credential_version credentialVersion, p.force_change_flag forceChange, p.status FROM t_password_credential p JOIN t_user_account a ON a.account_id=p.account_id WHERE p.account_id=#{accountId} AND p.algorithm_code='ARGON2ID' AND a.realm='CUSTOMER' AND a.account_type='HUMAN'

SELECT signing_key_id id, kid, kms_key_ref keyRef, public_jwk_canonical_json publicJwk, not_before notBefore, version FROM t_jwt_signing_key WHERE realm='CUSTOMER' AND status='ACTIVE' AND active_slot=1 AND algorithm='RS256' AND signing_end_time IS NULL AND verification_end_time IS NULL
SELECT FROM t_auth_session WHERE session_id=#{sessionId} AND realm='CUSTOMER' AND channel='CLIENT'
SELECT FROM t_auth_session WHERE session_id=#{sessionId} AND realm='CUSTOMER' AND channel='CLIENT' FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM t_refresh_token_generation r JOIN t_auth_session s ON s.session_id=r.session_id WHERE r.token_lookup_id=#{lookup} AND s.realm='CUSTOMER' AND s.channel='CLIENT'
SELECT FROM t_refresh_token_generation r JOIN t_auth_session s ON s.session_id=r.session_id WHERE r.token_lookup_id=#{lookup} AND s.realm='CUSTOMER' AND s.channel='CLIENT' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE t_user_account SET consecutive_password_failures=CASE WHEN locked_until IS NOT NULL AND locked_until<=#{now} THEN 1 ELSE consecutive_password_failures+1 END, locked_until=CASE WHEN consecutive_password_failures>=10 THEN TIMESTAMPADD(MINUTE, 15, #{now}) ELSE NULL END, last_password_failure_time=#{now}, version=version+1, update_time=#{now} WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND realm='CUSTOMER' AND account_type='HUMAN' AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND status='ACTIVE' AND (locked_until IS NULL OR locked_until<=#{now})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_auth_session(session_id, account_id, realm, channel, context_type, tenant_id, tenant_member_id, authentication_method, account_auth_epoch, credential_version_snapshot, issued_time, last_reauthenticated_time, last_activity_time, idle_expire_time, absolute_expire_time, current_generation_no, status, version, create_time, update_time) VALUES(#{issue.sessionId}, #{issue.accountId}, 'CUSTOMER', 'CLIENT', 'ACCOUNT', NULL, NULL, 'PASSWORD', #{issue.accountEpoch}, #{issue.credentialVersion}, #{issue.issuedTime}, #{issue.issuedTime}, #{issue.issuedTime}, #{issue.idleExpireTime}, #{issue.absoluteExpireTime}, #{issue.generation}, 'ACTIVE', 1, #{issue.issuedTime}, #{issue.issuedTime})

INSERT INTO t_refresh_token_generation(refresh_generation_id, session_id, generation_no, token_lookup_id, token_secret_hmac, hmac_key_version, issued_time, expires_time, status, active_slot, version, create_time, update_time) VALUES(#{issue.refreshId}, #{issue.sessionId}, #{issue.generation}, #{issue.refreshLookup}, #{issue.refreshHmac}, #{issue.refreshKeyVersion}, #{issue.issuedTime}, #{issue.absoluteExpireTime}, 'ISSUED', 1, 1, #{issue.issuedTime}, #{issue.issuedTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_refresh_token_generation SET replaced_by_generation_id=#{nextId}, version=version+1 WHERE refresh_generation_id=#{id} AND status='CONSUMED' AND replaced_by_generation_id IS NULL
